Being for real with you guys, I am legitimately scared that shit is about to hit the fan fast and hard and I am not prepared and will not have time to prepare.

No one can predict the future, some say the economy should've crashed earlier but the government bailed out banks to the tune of $500bil, which no one predicted.

Prepare yourself the best you can, but don't let it consume you, enjoy the day!

There are a lot of people willing to fudge the markets until they figure out how to prop them up. That's all the Feds have been doing for the past ever. Don't worry too much. It's a system built on trust and the average person is still too stupid to look behind the curtain.

The first thing to prepare is your mind. It doesn't matter how much you stock, plant or cache if you don't have the proper mindset.

So, take some time and breath. Your goal is to survive, thrive, and help others you care about do the same. Pay less attention to all the predictions of gloom and doom and how everything might go sideways tomorrow. Pay more attention to what YOU want and how YOU want to live...regardless of what happens. Then, take your time and move towards that way of living at a pace that YOU are comfortable with.

For example: Don't grow your own crops because the global food supply might tank. Grow your own crops because you prefer knowing where they came from, the state of the soil they grew in, and so on. Don't get into solar power because the grid might go down. Get into it because you believe in decreasing your use of fossil fuel based power and want to live more efficiently....knowing exactly where your power comes from and managing your usage appropriately.

Then, if things go south, you're truly prepared...because you're living the life you want anyway!

Society will not collapse tomorrow, so you have a bit more time. And when society collapses, it doesn't happen overnight. You're not going to walk out the door to find your neighbors all in a giant brawl. It's going to be gradual. One could argue that society is already beginning to collapse in places like Sweden and Germany. It's more of a whittle-down rather than a straight up collapse though.

Calm. Down. Loosing your calm will fail you regardless of the situation. You've decided bugging out isn't an option, that's nothing to panic over. Find out what community organizations are in your area. Make time to get acquainted with your neighbors. Keep in touch with your friends and relatives. No matter how busy you get, make sure they get birthday cards, anniversary cards, Christmas cards and the like. If you're not in shape, get in shape. The ladies and your body will appreciate it. If you've been taking a break from studying martial arts get back to it. If you're completely new, take up boxing. Boxers master basic defense in the weeks, while it takes other martial artists years. Best of luck to you.
